name: TheoremQA
description: A theorem-driven question answering dataset containing 800 high-quality questions covering 350+ theorems from Math, Physics, EE&CS, and Finance. Designed to evaluate AI models' capabilities to apply theorems to solve challenging university-level science problems.
typical_sota_score: ~50–65% (frontier models as of 2024; requires genuine theorem application not just recall)
reputation: Published at EMNLP 2023; covers theorems across multiple STEM disciplines; challenging benchmark requiring application of formal theorems rather than recall
notes: Published at EMNLP 2023. Covers 350+ theorems from four domains: Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, and Finance. Questions require models to apply theorem knowledge to solve novel problems, not just recall theorem statements. GPT-4 achieves ~51% with CoT prompting at time of release.
